clips.title: The story
paras: Across the southern Barrens, Washte Pawne's quill leaves a sting that hunters carry to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo. Its pain makes the hunt a trial of regret for the tauren.

Thunderhawks are elusive creatures of the Barrens, and wandering nomadic tribes treat them with reverence. Washte Pawne means “Spirit Biter” in Taurahe and holds a special place among them. Its death is no ordinary hunt: shamans whisper that striking down a thunderhawk can bring omens of triumph or misfortune.

After Washte Pawne falls, its feather burns with a pain that lingers on the skin. Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo explains that the ache is not poison, but regret. Taking a magnificent life bears a burden. The hunter must face that sorrow and turn it into lasting wisdom.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The feather of Washte Pawne is painful to the touch.

clips.title: Progress
paras: There is new resolve within you, friend. A resolve born from pain...
Are you burdened with the death of Washte Pawne?

clips.title: Completion
paras: The thunderhawk is a rare beast of the Barrens, and its death can portend great fortune, or great doom.
But Washte Pawne, called "Spirit Biter" in Taurahe, can bring neither... Or both.
The pain you felt from hunting Spirit Biter is the pang all feel who make great gains at great costs. The sting you felt is the pain of regret.
But I can see you have conquered this. You have learned that regret turns to wisdom, and that through pain one gains strength.
